content:
With WhatsApp officially rolling out the username feature, users can now save a username in addition to a name and phone number when saving contacts. Here are the relevant details.

The new username field feature is gradually being rolled out to some WhatsApp users

Although usernames are a basic feature on most instant messaging platforms, WhatsApp has only recently begun to move away from relying entirely on phone numbers to identify users.

WhatsApp began rolling out a username reservation system earlier this year, allowing users to register their desired usernames in advance to prevent impersonation and scams when the feature officially launched.

A few weeks ago, WhatsApp began enabling the username feature for some iPhone users.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp has started supporting users filling in the username field when adding new contacts. This field is displayed between the name field and the phone number field.

WABetaInfo reports:

WABetaInfo pointed out that the username field appears to be gradually rolling out to specific users on WhatsApp Beta and the official version.

When I tested with the latest official version, although the field was displayed, the system still showed the message "This username is not on WhatsApp", even if the username actually exists.

Nevertheless, this feature marks WhatsApp finally catching up with its competitors and adding a feature that many people believe should have been introduced long ago.
